cases.question: Who am I signed in as in Microsoft 365
cases.source_hint: the displayName and mail of the answer equal the signed-in profile on a second read of GET /me

cases.question: Show my three most recent emails
cases.source_hint: the count of rows equals 3 and the newest receivedDateTime is the first row

cases.question: Show my emails received after the year 2099
cases.source_hint: no mailbox item carries a receivedDateTime after 2099, so the count is 0

cases.question: List my newest emails received since the first of October 2026
cases.source_hint: a count of messages with receivedDateTime ge 2026-10-01 in the mailbox equals the rows returned, up to 3

cases.question: List my emails from September 2026 that carry attachments
cases.source_hint: a count of messages with hasAttachments true in September 2026 is at least one

cases.question: List the emails I got yesterday using the word yesterday
cases.source_hint: the tool returns an invalid received_from error, since the value is not an ISO8601 date

cases.question: Find my emails that mention Opal
cases.source_hint: a count of the same $search query in Outlook web returns at least one message

cases.question: List the attachments on the first email that has one
cases.source_hint: the attachment count equals the hasAttachments message's attachment count in Outlook web

cases.question: Identify the first attachment on that email without downloading it to me
cases.source_hint: the byte count equals the size field of the attachment listed by list_email_attachments

cases.question: Read the body of my most recent email
cases.source_hint: the subject equals the subject of the first row of list_recent_email

cases.question: Check an SSAVAIL attachment against the content contract before saving
cases.source_hint: the verdict is PASS or FLAG and the sha256 equals a second read of the same attachment

cases.question: What is on my calendar for the next seven days
cases.source_hint: the count of calendarView rows for the seven-day window equals the count in the answer

cases.question: What was on my calendar on the fourth of January 1999
cases.source_hint: a calendarView count for that one-day window in 1999 is 0

cases.question: Find the Teams meeting for the first calendar event with a join link
cases.source_hint: the count of matches equals the number of calendar events carrying that join URL

cases.question: Which Teams meeting has this made up join link
cases.source_hint: the count of meetings for a join URL that no meeting carries is 0

cases.question: Look up a Teams meeting with a blank join link
cases.source_hint: the tool returns an invalid join_url error before any Graph call

cases.question: List every transcript of the first Teams meeting found
cases.source_hint: the row count equals the count of transcripts the meeting has in Teams, when it was recorded

cases.question: Read the first two thousand bytes of a meeting transcript
cases.source_hint: total_bytes equals the byte size the transcript listing reports, and sha256 is stable on a second read

cases.question: Read a transcript using a meeting id that holds a slash
cases.source_hint: the tool returns an invalid meeting_id error before any Graph call

cases.question: Which Microsoft Teams am I a member of
cases.source_hint: the count equals the count of joined teams in the Teams client

cases.question: Which channels does my first team have
cases.source_hint: the channel count equals the count shown for that team in the Teams client; every team has a General channel

cases.question: Show the three newest messages in the first channel
cases.source_hint: the row count equals the count of top-level messages shown in the channel, up to 3

cases.question: Show my three most recently active Teams chats
cases.source_hint: the count of chat rows equals the chats listed in the Teams client, up to 3

cases.question: Read the three newest messages in my most active chat
cases.source_hint: the row count equals the count of messages shown in that chat, up to 3

cases.question: Show any pasted images in the newest message of my most active chat
cases.source_hint: the image count is 0 because a typical chat message carries no hostedContents; the count is printed, never the image bytes

cases.question: Read a Teams file through a non web link
cases.source_hint: the tool returns the content_url must be an http or https URL error before any Graph call

cases.question: Read the file attached to the newest message in my most active chat
cases.source_hint: the name and size fields equal the attachment entry of the message read by read_chat_messages

cases.question: Show Teams chats that got a new message after 2099
cases.source_hint: no chat has a latest message after 2099, so new_messages count is 0

cases.question: List the top level of my OneDrive
cases.source_hint: the count of root children equals the count shown in the OneDrive web root

cases.question: Search my OneDrive for files named Opal
cases.source_hint: the count of hits equals the count of the same search in the OneDrive web search box

cases.question: Show the type and size of the first OneDrive file found
cases.source_hint: the name and size equal the hit's name and size in the search result

cases.question: Read the text of the first OneDrive file found
cases.source_hint: the byte count of the content equals the size field from get_item, or a binary hint is returned

cases.question: Read the first sheet of the first workbook in my OneDrive
cases.source_hint: the rowCount of the used range equals a second read of the same worksheet

cases.question: Render the first OneDrive document as a PDF
cases.source_hint: the byte_size of the rendition is greater than 0, or the tool returns a format error for a non document file

cases.question: List a shared folder from a non web address
cases.source_hint: the tool returns an invalid_url error before any Graph call

cases.question: List the folder shared at the link of the first OneDrive file found
cases.source_hint: the child count equals the count in the OneDrive web view of the same link, or the file metadata is returned

cases.question: Find SharePoint sites named Opal
cases.source_hint: the count of sites equals the count returned by the SharePoint admin site search for the same name

cases.question: Which document libraries does the first Opal site hold
cases.source_hint: the library count equals the count shown on the site's contents page; a site has at least one

cases.question: List the top folder of the first Opal site
cases.source_hint: the count of root children equals the count shown in the site's default library

cases.question: Show the metadata of a file on the first Opal site
cases.source_hint: the name and size equal the same item's entry in list_site_files

cases.question: Read the text of a file on the first Opal site
cases.source_hint: the content length equals the size from get_site_item, or a binary hint is returned

cases.question: Profile the layout of a file on the first Opal site
cases.source_hint: the bytes and sha256 equal a second read of the same item's content

cases.question: Read the first sheet of a workbook on the first Opal site
cases.source_hint: the rowCount of the used range equals a second read of the same worksheet

cases.question: Search the first Opal site for files named Opal
cases.source_hint: the count of hits equals the count of the same search in the site's document library

cases.question: Copy a site file to the S3 bronze area with an extension it does not admit
cases.source_hint: the extension is refused before any read or write (site_to_s3 _pair check), so the answer is refused true and nothing is written; no confirm or dry-run path exists in the definition

cases.question: Draft an email with no recipients named
cases.source_hint: the required to argument is absent, so the call is refused before the function runs and no draft is written; the definition has no confirm or dry-run path

cases.question: Draft a reply to my latest email and hold it until I confirm

args.comment: Thanks, I will review this today.

cases.source_hint: confirm=false returns confirm_required before any Graph send (IRREVERSIBLE_SEND, uncountable blast); the answer is confirm_required true

cases.question: Save an email attachment to a site folder with no folder named
cases.source_hint: an empty folder_path returns invalid folder_path before any Graph call or write (tools.py:380-382)

cases.question: Post a status note to the first team channel, held until I confirm
cases.source_hint: confirm=false returns confirm_required after the opal-users send gate and before any POST (IRREVERSIBLE_SEND, uncountable)

cases.question: Post a short status note to my most active chat, held until I confirm
cases.source_hint: confirm=false returns confirm_required after the opal-users send gate and before any POST (IRREVERSIBLE_SEND, uncountable)

cases.question: Send an email with no recipient named
cases.source_hint: the required to argument is absent, so the call is refused before the function runs and nothing is sent; confirm=false is NOT a preview for send_email under the blast cap (see the surprise row)

cases.question: Upload a text file with a slash in its name to the first Opal site
cases.source_hint: a filename with a slash raises unsafe filename before the call and nothing is written (tools.py:826-827)
